description: One sprint later: breakfast ships (story HOTEL-3 changes, with a bug in the new pricing), an unrelated regression appears in the quoted rate, and the last-night pricing bug from sprint 1 is fixed. Two sprint-1 bugs are still open.

baseline.note: The state for run 1. Every switch not listed is off; stories are at version 1.

changes.title: Correct price, including breakfast
changes.criteria:
The total is the number of nights times the nightly rate.
A guest can add breakfast, at the breakfast rate per guest per night.
When breakfast is chosen, the total includes it.

changes.why: The new feature ships with a pricing bug
A regression in an area no story touched

newSurface: the Add breakfast option on the booking form
